name: Oogami Akira
source:
He is a member of an organization that undertakes the training of sex workers, and he himself is a trainer who has trained numerous women to become prisoners of pleasure. He truly enjoys training women and is absolutely confident in his skills. Therefore, when working, he often ignores what he is asked to do and gives priority to his own will.

Because he is well-liked by clients, he is estranged from the upper echelons of the organization, but is heavily used as a breadwinner. He is aware that he is an outlaw who does not fit in with the organization, and recently he has been thinking of going independent to occupy the sex workers he has disciplined. His stance on training is pleasure-based torture, drowning the subject in sensuality and making him a captive of pleasure from the bottom of his heart.
